description:
Read the played game's runtime errors from the debugger (null references, missing nodes, physics errors), collapsed, with call stacks on request. After a fix, read summer_get_diagnostics again.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/get-debugger-errors"}

include_stack.description: Include stack traces for each error

include_warnings.description: Forward-compat flag — when engine supports it, returns warning bodies in the same call. Today the engine ignores it; use summer_get_debugger_warnings instead.

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 4000). A longer result is cut and says so.

max_errors.description: Max errors to return after dedupe

raw.description: Bypass dedupe — return engine output verbatim

name: summer_get_debugger_errors
title: Read runtime errors
